detours.why: OSM maps no door on Hall 14; its pin snaps to the courtyard walk on its south-east side, and no mapped path leaves the hall west or north, so walks to the buildings west of Lumberjack Lodge go back round the hall and up the Lodge's east side to East College Street.

OSM maps no door on Lumberjack Landing or the Steen Library; Landing's pin snaps to the walk at its north-east corner, so walks west and south go round its east end and down beside Wilson Parking Garage, and the library is reached at its south-west corner.

OSM maps no door on Lumberjack Lodge; its pin snaps to the walk in its east courtyard, and the lane south of the Lodge isn't joined to the walk west of it, so walks south-west go north to East College Street, round Health Services and down the west side of Human Services.

OSM maps no doors on the Lumberjack Village buildings, and the courtyard walks inside the Village join the streets only at its north end, so walks east across Clark Boulevard and south across East Starr Avenue leave by the north and come back down Clark Boulevard; the Boynton House and the School of Social Work are reached from the drive and alley beside them.

OSM maps no door on Wisely Hall; its pin snaps to Aikman Drive on its south-west side, and no mapped path crosses past Aikman Drive Parking Garage, so the walk to Human Services goes north to East College Street and round Health Services.
